capabilities.scope: Rust and behavioral HDL represent power-on clear, CP shifting, active-low E parallel masking, and serial output independence.
limitations: The vectors do not establish physical gate-stage order or silicon timing.
The generic behavioral initializer requires target-specific synthesis evidence.
capabilities.next_gate: Compare a source-located stage-order corpus against an extracted gate representation.

capabilities.scope: The FPGA crate exports typed behavioral and FPGA-safe module requests with provenance manifests.
limitations: A parser, linter, or simulator result does not establish target synthesis or hardware behavior.
Partial modules retain explicit module-scoped lint exceptions.
capabilities.next_gate: Synthesize a complete target-specific module and retain the report.

capabilities.scope: The shared host HDL system composes generated 4004, 4001, and 4002 modules with deterministic two-phase timing, monitor ROM, RAM, and the UART bridge.
limitations: The host system instantiates one 4001 and one 4002 model and does not establish a complete multi-chip board memory map.
The UART bridge uses an explicit monitor convention and host simulation; it does not establish target synthesis, timing closure, or board behavior.
capabilities.next_gate: Synthesize the constrained mcs4_top source after the sys_clk_in board route is evidenced.

capabilities.scope: MCS-4 and MCS-40 systems emit deterministic eight-phase traces and CPU-owned TimingIo snapshots.
limitations: Timing windows model logical phase durations and do not model analog propagation.
System instruction accounting remains CPU-owned for multi-cycle instructions.
capabilities.next_gate: Attach source-located timing parameters and a calibrated transient comparison.

capabilities.scope: Versioned TraceFrame records carry behavioral provenance, stimulus hash, run and sequence identity, JSONL capture, transcript-backed behavioral replay checkpoints, and read-only GUI inspection of validated shared frames.
limitations: Replay reconstructs behavioral state from an explicit transcript and does not snapshot analog solver state or FPGA hardware state.
The i4003 Verilator adapter has no mapped whole-system signal contract, so comparison intentionally rejects it despite the shared JSON schema.
The full-system Verilator monitor scenario uses a scenario-byte stimulus hash and does not yet replay a behavioral ROM fixture with identical input events.
capabilities.next_gate: Run one shared ROM and input transcript through behavioral and full-system Verilator adapters, then retain the comparison result.

capabilities.scope: The active MCS-4 logical timing constants record source locators, bounds, use sites, limitations, and falsifiers.
limitations: The logical timing model does not establish transistor propagation or board-level skew.
The selected typical period is a deterministic simulation choice within the retained source interval.
capabilities.next_gate: Compare a calibrated transient or attended waveform against a retained source-qualified timing condition.

capabilities.scope: The 4040 solver bridge exposes a clearly named 4004 reference clock-buffer graph and no unsupported 4040 node mapping.
limitations: No extracted 4040 transistor netlist exists in this repository.
The reference graph does not establish 4040 physical pin or transistor evidence.
capabilities.next_gate: Ingest a provenance-backed 4040 netlist before adding physical node mappings.

capabilities.scope: The feature-gated SIMD helper executes lane-parallel fetch, register ADD, and 12-bit program-counter advance.
limitations: The helper is not a full I4004 instruction-set implementation.
The differential oracle covers only the documented subset.
capabilities.next_gate: Add a measured workload contract before making performance claims.

capabilities.scope: The canonical v1 netlist generator uses remapped anchors v1, output hashes, and crash-recoverable publication.
limitations: The v1 netlists remain partial extraction artifacts.
Transaction recovery protects artifact publication but does not infer missing physical connectivity.
capabilities.next_gate: Verify all generated evidence manifests through a repository-wide provenance gate.

capabilities.scope: The optional Qt6 host drives a Verilator model of generated i4003_fpga HDL and validates headless scenarios with VCD, JSON summary, and shared-schema JSONL trace-frame output.
limitations: The board is a host simulation, not FPGA synthesis or physical hardware validation.
CP is sampled through the FPGA-safe sys_clk wrapper rather than an asynchronous silicon clock path.
The i4003-only adapter has no shared whole-system stimulus or signal map and cannot prove behavioral-to-FPGA equivalence.
capabilities.next_gate: Retain a target synthesis report and attended board probe with the same scenario.

capabilities.scope: A headless Verilator adapter executes mcs4_system_sim_top with generated 4004, 4001, and 4002 HDL, records VCD and mapped shared-schema frames, checks monitor WMP, bus, and phase invariants, and consumes the common 256-byte ROM/reset/TEST/phase stimulus.
limitations: The monitor scenario is a host Verilator run with a staged ROM file, not target synthesis or board evidence.

The common stimulus proves exact input identity and records mapped-signal matches and mismatches; it does not prove phase alignment, behavioral equality, transistor-level equivalence, or board behavior.
capabilities.next_gate: Reconcile the recorded phase, bus, and ROM/RAM-control mismatches against a reviewed phase-boundary mapping before evaluating frame equality.

capabilities.scope: A clean-tree builder assembles source, generated i4003 FPGA HDL, scenario evidence, checksums, and validation logs into a non-release developer bundle.
limitations: The builder deliberately refuses this dirty working tree, so no current bundle is claimed as reproduced evidence.
The bundle excludes a release package, target bitstream, install operation, rollback operation, and hardware claim.
capabilities.next_gate: Run the builder from a clean committed revision and verify the retained manifest and checksums.

capabilities.scope: No reviewed sys_clk_in route, target-specific timing report, programmed-board capture, or rollback probe establishes physical FPGA conformance.
limitations: The repository retains host HDL and partial constraints but no assigned sys_clk_in board route or attended board capture.
Physical transistor-netlist extraction remains incomplete for 4001, 4002, and 4003.
capabilities.blocker: The clock-route, target-synthesis, attended-board, and physical-netlist acceptance records are incomplete.
capabilities.next_gate: Build a target-specific bitstream and run an attended waveform-backed board probe.
